title: Recap of past chats: sourdough starter and bike repair
description: The user asked Dorothy to look up past chat topics, then which chats carry the sourdough starter tag; she listed the two sourdough chat titles.
abstract: The user asked Dorothy to look up, not guess, what earlier chats covered. She recapped three conversations: two on sourdough (reviving a sluggish starter, covering feeding ratios, the acetone hunger smell and fridge storage; then spotting peak and a dense, gummy loaf, likely underproofed) and one on bike maintenance (gears skipping on small rear cogs, chain wear, likely cassette replacement, barrel adjuster use). The user then asked which chats carry the sourdough starter tag, and Dorothy named two: "Reviving a sluggish sourdough starter" and "Sourdough starter peak and a dense, gummy loaf". The user keeps asking for short answers and seems to be checking how her lookups work. Note: she said she checked her tags, though what she really had were her notes, so be careful to describe that accurately. Nothing new was decided. Still open: whether the starter smell faded, whether the next loaf improved, and whether the bike fix worked.
